aspect: It arrives whether you invite it or not
description: The contact is unsolicited. Not participating is not available; the only variable is how you respond.
energy_note: A stranger's business plan, aimed at you.

description: Your name, the last four digits, a recent transaction, your employer. Enough real context to sound legitimate, obtained from breaches you were never party to.
energy_note: Convincing, because the details are true.

description: Bank transfer and cryptocurrency have no chargeback, and those are exactly the methods the pressure steers you toward.
energy_note: Pushed onto the one road with no way back.

description: The number matched the one on the card. The caller knew the last transaction. She moved the money to a 'safe account' at 19:40 on a Thursday. The bank's position is that she authorised it.
energy_note: Not gullible. Targeted by a professional.

aspect: Proving you did not authorise it is your job
description: The dispute begins from the assumption that an authorised payment is authorised, and the evidence you would need is held by the bank.
Every unexpected call, link and message now requires a judgement. The tax is not the losses; it is never being able to answer the phone simply.
